urls.rationale: Chapter 24.45 - REGULATION OF LOBBYING is AK's full lobbyist registration and disclosure chapter (AS 24.45); directory-level leaf, pass-3 will expand to per-section URLs.

notes: Single-chapter regime. Chapter 24.60 (Standards of Conduct) and Title 39 ethics provisions are out of scope per pass-2 Rule 4 (general ethics rules not tied to lobbying disclosure).
